items.title: Frank Alkyer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 10, 2020
items.q: You know who I wouldn’t? Miles Davis.

ctx.x: If there’s one person, a musician, that you could have interviewed but was gone before, who would you have liked to have been able to sit with? That’s a hard question.
No, there’s a lot of them. You know who I wouldn’t? Miles Davis.
Well that’s interesting because of the writing and the editing you’ve done with the material.
